title: Tom and the Red Bike
text:
Tom has a red bike. He rides it to the park every Saturday. In the park, he meets his friend Ana. They play ball and eat ice cream. Ana has a blue dog named Max.

Tom and Ana play all afternoon. Max runs after the ball. At five o'clock, Tom goes home on his bike. He is happy because he had a great day.

questions.text: What time does Tom go home?
Why is Tom probably happy at the end of the story?
options: He spent a fun afternoon with his friend
He had to stay at school

questions.text: What is probably true about Max?
options: Max likes to play with the ball
Max is a cat that sleeps all day
Max does not like the park

vocabulary.definition: a public green area where people walk, play, and relax
a person you know well and like spending time with
a round object that children throw, kick, or catch when they play
the part of the day between lunch and evening

paragraph_translations: Tom ma czerwony rower. Co sobotę jeździ nim do parku. W parku spotyka swojego przyjaciela Anę. Grają w piłkę i jedzą lody. Ana ma niebieskiego psa o imieniu Max.
Tom i Ana bawią się całe popołudnie. Max biega za piłką. O piątej Tom wraca do domu na rowerze. Jest szczęśliwy, bo miał wspaniały dzień.
